stories.title: All-American Guadalajara Final — Jovic vs. Stearns

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
All-American WTA 500 final today in Guadalajara.

Defending champ Iva Jovic vs. Peyton Stearns — first career meeting. Jovic is chasing back-to-back titles. Stearns upset No. 8 Samsonova to get here.

Two Americans. One trophy. 🎾

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Jovic (career-high No. 13) vs. Stearns (unseeded) in the Guadalajara final.

Jovic def. Bucsa 6-4, 6-1. Stearns def. Samsonova 7-6, 6-2.

An all-American WTA final — when was the last time? 🇺🇸

article.headline: All-American WTA Final: Jovic Defends Title Against Stearns in Guadalajara

stories.title: Davis Cup — Canada on Brink of Final 8, Leads France 2-0

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Canada enters Day 2 up 2-0 on France in Davis Cup. Needs just one more point to reach Bologna.

Draxl def. Rinderknech 6-2, 7-5. FAA def. Halys 7-6, 4-6, 6-3 yesterday.

Doubles up first at 2 PM ET in Quebec City.

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
FAA and Liam Draxl have Canada on the doorstep of the Davis Cup Finals.

One more point today at Centre Vidéotron — doubles or reverse singles — and Canada is Bologna-bound.

France needs to win all 3 remaining rubbers. 🇨🇦

article.headline: Canada One Point Away: Davis Cup Qualifier Day 2 vs. France

stories.title: Czechia vs. USA Davis Cup — Tied 1-1, Shelton Stumbles in Return

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
Ben Shelton's first match since the US Open final ended in a 6-4, 6-4 loss to Jiri Lehecka in Davis Cup Prague.

Learner Tien gave USA the lead with a brilliant debut — 6-2, 6-4 over Mensik.

Tied 1-1. Doubles up today.

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
USA vs. Czechia is tied 1-1 heading into the doubles in Prague.

Harrison/Krajicek vs. the Czechs. Then reverse singles — can Shelton bounce back vs. Lehecka?

Big Davis Cup day. Bologna spot on the line.

article.headline: Shelton Stumbles, Tien Shines: USA and Czechia Tied 1-1 in Davis Cup

stories.title: Great Britain vs. Ecuador — Davis Cup Kicks Off at Copper Box

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Great Britain opens Davis Cup action today vs. Ecuador at the Copper Box, London.

Cameron Norrie, Arthur Fery and doubles world No. 1 Henry Patten lead the team. Day 2 is Sunday.

Bologna Finals spot up for grabs. 🇬🇧

article.headline: Great Britain vs. Ecuador: Davis Cup Qualifier Opens at Copper Box London

stories.title: Laver Cup Six Days Out — Team World's Tien in Dual-Nation Drama

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Learner Tien is playing Davis Cup for the USA in Prague today.

In six days he'll be in London playing for Team World at the Laver Cup.

Jakub Mensik: Davis Cup for Czechia this weekend → Team Europe next weekend.

Tennis is something else.

article.headline: Six Days to Laver Cup: Tien's Dual-Nation Week and a Reshuffled Team World
